estilo: Children's picture-book illustration, flat vector style with soft rounded shapes and clean medium-weight outlines, warm bright pastel palette, friendly and simple, plain white background, single centered subject, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, safe for young children
negativo: text, letters, words, numbers, watermark, logo, brand names, realistic photo, scary, dark, creepy, gore, extra fingers, distorted hands, blurry, cluttered background

personajes.Lin: Lin: 7-year-old Chinese boy, short straight black hair with a small fringe, round friendly face, big dark eyes; at school he wears a white Argentine school smock (guardapolvo) over a red sweater and a blue backpack; at home a yellow T-shirt
personajes.Sofi: Sofi: 7-year-old Argentine girl, light-brown wavy hair in two ponytails with sky-blue ribbons, warm tan skin, freckles, big smile; white school smock (guardapolvo)
personajes.Seño: Seño: young woman teacher in her thirties, shoulder-length dark brown hair, round glasses, kind smile; white school smock (guardapolvo) over a light-blue blouse
personajes.Mamá: Mamá (Lin's mother): Chinese woman in her thirties, black hair in a low ponytail, gentle smile; green cardigan, often with a kitchen apron
personajes.Kiosquero: Kiosquero: friendly middle-aged Argentine man with a grey moustache and a flat cap, striped apron, behind the window of a small street kiosk
personajes.Familia de Sofi: Sofi's family: father (short dark beard, plaid shirt), mother (curly hair, orange top), grandmother (grey hair in a bun, lilac cardigan), little brother (toddler, round cheeks)
